## Deploy readiness board (R100, informational)

This check is informational on pull requests during the pre-launch
burn-down. It gates only the codebase-invariant sections (stub values
and prod-switch coherence). The environment-dependent sections (wiring,
env discovery, operator keys) are surfaced below but do not block the
PR because the runner carries no production secrets. The prod-deploy
gate (deploy-readiness-gate) enforces every section under strict mode.

FIX ROUND 3 (B-RECUR-116, agent 116) — growth-project-backend#679 @ 958806d15af64863786337699020428cd89ffaf3

Round on the split of #654 @ `02c48de7` (rounds 1-2 were posted on #654). Open findings at start, both lenses:
- GPT-6.1 Sol, unposted draft REQUEST CHANGES 0/3/0 at `02c48de7`: **B-654-5 (narrowed)**, **B-654-8**, **B-654-9** (summarized in tgp-agent-context `handoffs/op-115/reports/AUD-SOL-MONEY-115.md` and `AUD-SOL-MONEY-2-115.md`).
- Claude Opus 5.5, APPROVE 0/0/3 at `02c48de7` ([5972187301](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/654#issuecomment-5972187301)): **C-654-8** (= B-654-5 narrowed), **C-654-10** (= B-654-9), C-654-9 (mobile; closed by mobile #334 round 3, nothing here).

All of the code lives in this piece: `src/checkout/subscription-checkout.service.ts` and the new `src/checkout/error-label.ts`. The tests are in #680 with the other fix-round specs, so this piece stays under the size limit (2,952 changed lines, was 2,863). #678 is unchanged.

| Finding | Change | Commit | Test (failed before, passes after) |
|---|---|---|---|
| B-654-5 narrowed / C-654-8: an uncertain create was resent blindly, so after Stripe's 24 h key retention the attempt got a second subscription | `mintSubscription`: any retry of an attempt whose terms are pinned (an earlier create may have reached Stripe) reads Stripe first by `metadata.tgp_purchase_id`. Found: bound, never re-created. Unreadable: `PAYMENT_RETRY`, nothing sent, the retry marker stays. None, and the attempt is 23 h or older: `SUBSCRIPTION_ATTEMPT_EXPIRED` (`timed_out`), nothing created; a new key re-decides price and trial eligibility. None inside the window: the identical pinned request under the same key, after the lookup. | `958806d1` | #680 `test/b-recur-116-fix-round-3.spec.ts`, block "B-654-5 narrowed / C-654-8": 6 cases (trial and paid after key loss, past-window miss, in-window miss resends after the lookup, unreadable, found-but-ended) |
| B-654-8: a failed or unavailable cancel still expired a payable attempt (and a new key then minted a second subscription) | New `cancelConfirmed()`: a cancel counts only if Stripe answered it, or a read-back shows `canceled` / `incomplete_expired`. `retireAttempt` (same key, terms changed), the `tryReuse` stale path (new key) and `finishBound`'s no-sheet path end the attempt only after a confirmed cancel. Otherwise the answer is `PAYMENT_RETRY` (an unbound row goes back to the retry marker), and no new attempt or subscription is made. `tryReuse`: a subscription Stripe shows `past_due` / `unpaid` still charges, so it is the client's plan: `SUBSCRIPTION_ALREADY_ACTIVE` (before, it was expired and a second one minted). `sheetSecret` never returns a secret of an ended subscription. `retireAttempt`: an unreadable lookup keeps the retry marker. | `958806d1` | same spec, block "B-654-8": 5 cases + 1 control (cancel answer lost after Stripe canceled: reconciled, ended) |
| B-654-9 / C-654-10: `errorLabel` let an arbitrary `Error.name` and any identifier-shaped code into logs; six catch lines still logged `err.message` | `errorLabel` moved to `src/checkout/error-label.ts`, closed allow-lists only: `stripe:<type>:<status>:<code>` (Stripe types and codes from fixed lists, else `other`), `http:<status>`, Prisma `P` + 4 digits, fixed network codes, fixed class names; anything else is `error`. The six remaining service catch lines (drop reservation, cancel, stale-trial cleanup x2, replay check, trial-card attach) log the label. The three new webhook handler lines are changed in #680. | `958806d1` | same spec, block "B-654-9 / C-654-10": 7 cases with an address canary, plus label controls |

**Failing-before.** Test-only commit `323b27c7` on the #680 head `7e55cfcb`, one-job CI lane: [run 37172350469](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37172350469). It is red: 19 failed / 1 passed. The one pass is the lost-cancel-answer control. The "controls: known ... stay readable" case failed before only because the label form changed; its P2002 / ECONNRESET / TypeError parts held before too.

**After.** Locally (`heavy.sh jest --runInBand`), all 8 b-recur suites pass, 153/153, at #680 `2b10687c`. Required checks at this head: all 7 running required checks green (build-and-test [job 111348789748](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37172708421/job/111348789748), rls-floor-guard, rls-live-tests, mwb-3-live-tests, community-live-tests, npm audit, Schema parity); CodeQL, danger, Banned cast tokens and build-sbom run only once the stack is based on main (no `as any` / `as never` / `as unknown as` / empty-catch tokens added).

**Pre-push checklist.**
- (a) Logs carry ids and allow-listed labels only; no message, address or token.
- (b) Every state write after a Stripe await is a conditional `updateMany` on the same purchase id (`status: 'pending'`, `stripe_subscription_id: null` or `entitlement_active: false`), so a concurrent grant or retire wins. Nothing here is account- or session-scoped beyond the client-scoped row.
- (c) Races: `claimUnbound` is still the single atomic takeover. A lost cancel answer is reconciled by a read-back (control test).
- (d) Copy: no new strings. The existing coded answers are reused: `PAYMENT_RETRY`, `SUBSCRIPTION_ATTEMPT_EXPIRED`, `SUBSCRIPTION_SETUP_UNAVAILABLE`, `SUBSCRIPTION_ALREADY_ACTIVE`.
- (e) Failing-before run above.
- (f) Size: #679 is 2,952 changed lines.

**Notes for the lenses.**
- Each retry now costs one extra Stripe list call. It uses `status=all, limit=100`; `has_more` without a hit counts as unreadable, so the answer is a retry, never a guess.
- The 23 h bound reuses `OPEN_ATTEMPT_MAX_AGE_MS`, a margin under Stripe's 24 h retention. It is measured from the reservation's `created_at`, which is earlier than the first create, so it errs toward ending.
- #654 stays at `02c48de7` as the superseded original. The tree at #680 is now #654 plus this round.

READY FOR AUDIT
